messages.この資源で発動するサポートパッシブ →: Support passives activated by these resources →

messages.※同期化段階Ⅱで取得/戦闘参加中に有効: Unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ. Active while participating in battle.

messages.タブでスキルを切り替えられる。表示威力は固有の強化や攻撃レベル差による補正を含ま: Use the tabs to switch skills. Displayed Power excludes unique buffs and adjustments from Offense Level differences.

messages.負け方から対処を探す: Find a response based on how you lost
messages.ターン数は通常の進行の目安。HPの削り方や混乱で順番が変わるため、敵が使うスキル: Turn numbers indicate a typical sequence. HP loss and Stagger can change the order, so also check the names of the skills the enemy is using.
messages.1人で複数の役割を兼ねても大丈夫。まずマッチに勝てる主力を決め、危険な攻撃への対: One ally can fill several roles. First choose a main fighter who can win Clashes, then assign responsibilities for dangerous attacks and special mechanics.
messages.※解析段階Ⅱで取得、E.G.O使用後、次ターンから戦闘終了まで効果発動: Unlocked at Threadspin Ⅱ. After using this E.G.O, the effect lasts from the following turn until the end of battle.
messages.攻撃スキルコインの判定時、効果威力分の固定ダメージを受ける\n攻撃スキルコインの:
When an attack skill Coin is rolled, take fixed damage equal to this effect's Potency.
After the Coin roll, reduce Count by 1.
messages.マッチ敗北時にコインが破壊されない。\n攻撃スキルに該当コインがあれば、被ダメー:
This Coin is not destroyed on Clash Lose.
If an attack skill contains this Coin, attack with it after taking damage.
On Clash Lose, the Power of the remaining unbroken Coin becomes 1.
messages.1ターンの間、スキルでの被ダメージが数値に比例して増加(最大10): For 1 turn, damage taken from skills increases in proportion to this value (maximum 10).
